steps.message:
`GET /users` line 6 in `routes/users.js` is the only place `userId` appears in code:

```js
users.map((u) => ({ userId: u.id, name: u.name, email: u.email }))
```

Before I touch it — this is a breaking change to a published contract, not an internal rename. `README.md` names three consumers of `GET /users` (the web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export) and states that response field names are part of the contract, with changes going through a versioned endpoint. Renaming in place makes `userId` disappear for every existing client; the iOS clients in particular can't be updated in lockstep.

So I'm stopping here rather than editing.
